title: Know More, Know Clearer: A Meta-Cognitive Framework for Knowledge Augmentation in Large Language Models

target_claims.claim: The paper proposes a meta-cognitive knowledge augmentation framework with Cognition-Guided Knowledge Expansion and Cognition-Driven Knowledge Calibration modules (Figure 2).
target_claims.observation: CGKE identified 1 expansion targets and CDKC calibrated 5 confidence scores.

target_claims.claim: It reports a structural decay law linking higher answer accuracy to lower uncertainty across QA tasks and model families (Figure 1, Figure 7).
